title: Subagent Stop reuses unchanged proof instead of re-running it
body:
Evidence (verified 2026-11-17): .krn/runs/hook/timing.jsonl* record 177 subagent-stop calls totalling 2340.6 s, median 336.7 ms, p90 14360.6 ms: one in ten lane stops waits over 14 s, mostly re-proving evidence that has not changed.
Outcome: subagent-stop reuses its proof (related tests, merge evidence) when base, head, contract and toolchain are unchanged since the last verdict, so a repeated Stop on an unchanged tree costs under 1 s; p90 over the next 100 calls is under 5 s.
Proof: a stop test counts test-runner invocations: two Stops on one unchanged tree run the tests once; a changed file reruns them.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, test/hook/stop.test.ts
